sentences.en: I would kill for a plate of polo right now.
sentences.zh: 我现在简直想吃一盘波洛甜点。

sentences.en: I objected when the waiter tried to remove my plate.
sentences.zh: 当服务员试图撤走我的盘子时，我提出了异议。

sentences.en: Fold the napkins and put one by each plate.
sentences.zh: 把餐巾折好，每个盘子旁边放一个。

senses.zh: 镀金；电镀；为...制印版给...装钢板
